text:
Maya Patel: Quick FYI — SDK v1.5 release window is next Tue. Need a short preflight: owners for sample apps, quickstarts, docs changelog cutoff, and any remaining API surface PRs. can owners ack and list blockers?
Sam Huang: I can take SDK packaging + Py/TS samples. planning to cut the package on Monday morning PST.
Diego Ramos: I'll own the sample apps runbook and CI smoke. there are 2 failing flaky tests in sampleapp-e2e (#432, #439) — will triage today.
Zara Kim: I'll handle docs updates and changelog assembly. what's our cutoff for changelog entries?
Maya Patel: cutoff = Mon 09:00 PDT for final entries. after that only critical fixes. please flag anything late.
Sam Huang: noted. attaching the branch where I pinned deps: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/compare/release-v1.5
Diego Ramos: quick note — sampleapps depend on runtime change in eng-runtime PR #1287. if that doesn't land by Mon noon we need a compat fallback. @eng-runtime FYI.
Zara Kim: rough checklist from docs POV:
- update quickstarts (py/ts)
- verify console screenshots
- add changelog bullets from merged PRs
- run spellcheck pipeline
I'll ping when drafts are up.
Maya Patel: Good checklist. owner assignments: SDK packaging -> @Sam Huang, sample apps + CI -> @Diego Ramos, docs + changelog -> @Zara Kim. I'll coordinate release notes and the release post.
docs-bot: CHANGELOG REMINDER: please add entries to `docs/changelog/unreleased.md`. Automated release script will read that file.
Sam Huang: For packaging, I have a pre-release tag ready. command I use to build and lint:
```
make clean && make build && tox -e py39
```
I'll run that on Mon 06:30 PDT and open the release PR.
Diego Ramos: CI plan: toggle sampleapps to use runtime-stable branch if eng-runtime not merged. quick fallback patch prepared: `samples/compat/fallback-runtime.yml`.
Zara Kim: For changelog format — please use one-line bullets with PR number and a short one-sentence summary, e.g. `#439 — fix sample e2e timeout`. saves me formatting time.
Maya Patel: Two blockers I know of: eng-runtime PR dependency (Diego mentioned) and a documentation image update that needs a new console screenshot (blocked on console staging). if either slips we may push a docs-only patch post-release.
Sam Huang: will notify infra to prioritize console staging screenshot slot Mon morning.
Diego Ramos: triage update: #432 flaky test root cause identified (timing). quick PR incoming in ~2h.
Zara Kim: I'll start drafting the release notes now with current merged PRs and leave placeholders for last-minute entries.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. Final ask: drop single-line status in this thread when your piece is green (e.g., "sam: packaging green"). makes the release countdown easier. :thumbsup:
Sam Huang: sam: packaging green (will update if anything breaks)
Diego Ramos: diego: sampleapps CI green after fixes
Zara Kim: zara: docs draft uploaded, changelog skeleton ready
Maya Patel: maya: coordinating release post + change log review. will merge when all green.
docs-bot: AUTOMATION: Release checklist created at https://internal.redwood.dev/releases/v1.5/checklist
Maya Patel: closing loop — if anything unexpectedly blocks after cutoff call out in #eng-oncall and notify me directly. otherwise proceed with the plan. thanks everyone! :rocket:
